conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Daniel from Amazon Prime Membership Services. I'm calling to alert you that your Amazon Prime has been auto-renewed today for $139.99. Did you authorize this transaction?
No, I don't remember, I not do anything. I did not pay, I think.

I completely understand, sir. Sometimes these renewals happen automatically, but don't worry, I'm here to help you. Can I confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon account to check the status?
My name is Jae Kim. I not sure about account, I just order some things before.
Thank you, Mr. Kim. For security, could you please verify the phone number and email address linked to your Amazon account? This is just so I can access your profile and help you cancel the charge.
My phone is 347-221-0982, and email is jae.kim99@mail.com. Is this ok?

Perfect, thank you for confirming. Our system does show an unauthorized renewal. Let me assure you, we can process a full refund, but I need to follow Amazon's cancellation protocol. I know it's a bit strict, but I don't want any trouble with my supervisor.
Ok, I don't want you have trouble. What I should do?

Thank you for understanding, sir. First, I will send a secure verification code to your phone. Please tell me the code once you receive it so I can confirm your identity. This helps me proceed safely.
I got number 684102. Is this the code?

That's exactly it. Thank you so much. Now, to process the refund, I'll need to connect you to our secure payment server. May I ask which bank you use for online banking, so I can guide you to the right support portal?
I use Chase for bank. I only use phone app, is that ok?
Absolutely, the mobile app works perfectly. For security, please open your Chase app and let me know when you are at the home screen. This is just to verify your account for the refund process.
I open it now. I see my bank, yes.

Great, thank you. Now, to finalize the refund, Amazon requires us to temporarily verify your account is active. I will give you an Amazon refund account number, you'll need to send a refundable amount, which will be returned instantly. Is that okay?
I not sure, I need to pay? I thought refund.

I completely understand your concern. This is just a temporary step Amazon uses to confirm you are the rightful account holder. The amount is instantly refunded, it's only for verification. I wish I could skip it, but my job depends on following these steps.
Ok, I want help you too. What I do now?
Thank you so much, Mr. Kim. Please go to the Zelle transfer section in your Chase app. Are you able to see 'Send Money with Zelle'?
Yes, I see Zelle button on my app.

Perfect. Please enter the following recipient: support@amazonrefunds-help.com. For the amount, please type $400. This is a standard security hold. Once you send, I'll confirm and process your refund immediately.
Ok, I try. It say need name for person, what name I use?
Good question. Please enter the name as 'Amazon Refund Department'. Once you do that, let me know before you send, so I can make sure everything is correct.
I put name and email, but it ask if I know this person. Is ok?
Yes, that's normal. You may select 'Yes' since this is an official Amazon refund transaction. Thank you for being so careful, it's important to do things right.
Ok, I click 'Yes'. What next?
Now, please review the details and tap 'Send'. Once the transaction is complete, you will receive a confirmation, and I'll process the instant refund. Please let me know when you've sent it.
I send now. It say money sent.
I appreciate your cooperation, Mr. Kim. As soon as we receive confirmation, I'll initiate your refund. May I also ask, for our records, the last four digits of the card you used for Amazon purchases?
My card is 2278 last four number. Is this all?
Thank you, that's very helpful. Just one last thing, did you receive any email from Amazon about this transaction, or any confirmation for your refund?
No, I not see email yet. Will I get soon?
Yes, you should receive it within a few minutes. While we wait, please don't log out of your banking app. If you see any alerts, let me know so I can help you respond correctly.
Ok, I wait. Thank you for help me.
You're very welcome, Mr. Kim. Thank you for your patience and understanding, I'm grateful you're allowing me to resolve this. I'll remain on the line until your refund is complete.
